# iosxr_http_client (Resource)

This resource can manage the HTTP Client configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxr_http_client" "example" {
  vrf                        = "MGMT"
  secure_verify_peer_disable = true
  secure_verify_host_disable = true
  response_timeout           = 60
  connection_timeout         = 30
  connection_retry           = 5
  source_interface_ipv4      = "MgmtEth0/RP0/CPU0/0"
  version_default            = true
  tcp_window_scale           = 14
  ssl_version_tls13          = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `connection_retry` (Number) Configure retry count in case of connection establishment
  - Range: `1`-`5`
- `connection_timeout` (Number) How long HTTP Client waits for a server connection to establish before giving up
  - Range: `1`-`60`
- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `response_timeout` (Number) Response timeout
  - Range: `1`-`300`
- `secure_verify_host_disable` (Boolean) Disable verifying host in peer's certificate
- `secure_verify_peer_disable` (Boolean) Disable verifying peer's certificate
- `source_interface_ipv4` (String) Select an soucre interface
- `source_interface_ipv6` (String) Select an soucre interface
- `ssl_version_tls10` (Boolean) Force TLSv1.0 to be used for HTTPS requests
- `ssl_version_tls11` (Boolean) Force TLSv1.1 to be used for HTTPS requests
- `ssl_version_tls12` (Boolean) Force TLSv1.2 to be used for HTTPS requests
- `ssl_version_tls13` (Boolean) Force TLSv1.3 to be used for HTTPS requests
- `tcp_window_scale` (Number) Set tcp window-scale factor for High Latency links
  - Range: `1`-`14`
- `version_10` (Boolean) force HTTP1.0 to be used for all HTTP requests
- `version_11` (Boolean) force HTTP1.1 to be used for all HTTP requests
- `version_default` (Boolean) libcurl will pick HTTP version automatically
- `vrf` (String) Name of vrf

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxr_http_client.example ""
```
